title: Life after Salah - why Isak and Wirtz must step up for Liverpool
summary: Liverpool faces a new era without Mohamed Salah for the first time in a decade, relying on emerging talents like Isak and Wirtz to fill the void. The club has not yet signed a direct replacement for their star winger. This transition represents a significant challenge as the team adapts to life without one of their most consistent attacking threats.
content: Liverpool are preparing to begin a season without Mohamed Salah for the first time in a decade - but they haven't replaced him yet. This is why.

zh.title: 告别萨拉赫 - 伊萨克和维尔茨为何必须为利物浦挺身而出
zh.summary: 利物浦十年来首次面临没有穆罕默德·萨拉赫的新时代,依赖伊萨克和维尔茨等新兴人才来填补空缺。俱乐部还未为其明星边锋签署直接替代者。这一转变对球队适应失去最稳定的进攻威胁之一构成重大挑战。

title: Relive: Keegan's Newcastle lose thriller to Liverpool
summary: BBC Sport revisits one of the Premier League's greatest matches, in which Kevin Keegan's Newcastle lost a thrilling game to Liverpool decades ago. Both clubs will pay tribute to Keegan before their upcoming Premier League opener at St James' Park. The throwback highlights a significant moment in the enduring rivalry between the two sides.
content:
BBC Sport looks back at one of the Premier League's best ever games as Newcastle, then managed by Kevin Keegan, lost a thriller to Liverpool.

Both clubs will pay tribute to Keegan before their Premier League opener at St James' Park.

zh.title: 重温:基根的纽卡斯尔惜败于利物浦
zh.summary: 英国广播公司体育回顾英超历史最伟大的比赛之一,基根执教的纽卡斯尔在数十年前的激烈比赛中不敌利物浦。两队将在圣詹姆斯公园即将开始的英超首轮比赛前向基根致敬。这一回顾强调了两队之间持久对抗中的重要时刻。
